messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — embargo window for the launch will be Tue Apr 12 08:00–12:00 PT. Need to lock analyst briefings + one EU-friendly slot. Who can help run the syncs?

Jamal: I can lead the US/NA briefings. Can we confirm the analyst list? Also need PR approvals on the quote we plan to hand out.

Priya: Sending draft calendar in a sec. We should keep 30-min briefing blocks + 15-min fact-check buffer after each. EU slot suggestion: 16:00 UTC (early EU morning) or 09:00 BST depending on analyst availability.

Maria: Putting a short Q/A + demo in the 30-min block. Will anyone present deep-dive benchmarks? Lucas?

Lucas: I can take the benchmark walk-through for the first two US slots. Quick reminder — numbers we discussed are final: 26% latency reduction vs baseline and 1.8x cost-per-token savings (95% CI). Use exact phrasing from the doc.

Claire (Legal): Heads-up from legal: quote approvals need 24h turnaround. Please route final quote text to me by Mon EOD so we can clear before embargo. No forward-looking promises in the quote.

Maria: Got it. Draft quote here — please review:

"Redwood Inference delivers a 26% latency improvement and 1.8x reduction in per-token cost compared to the baseline, enabling predictable inference economics at scale."

Jamal: Nice. Two notes: (1) press might want a single-sentence soundbite for emails; (2) analysts will ask about test harness and datasets — have a one-paragraph tech appendix ready.

Priya: Link to factcheck doc: https://docs.google.com/launch-factcheck (please add sources & test commands). Deadline for additions: Mon 14:00 PT.

Maria: @Claire can you confirm the quote above is OK or suggest edits? @Lucas can you paste the short technical appendix (1 paragraph) here?

Claire (Legal): Edit request — remove "predictable" (subjective). Revised quote:

"Redwood Inference achieved a 26% latency improvement and a 1.8x reduction in per-token cost versus the baseline in our benchmark suite."

Lucas: Tech appendix (short): "Benchmarks run on 8xA100 instances with sequence length 1024 using continuous batching and KV cache enabled. Workloads were from a mix of conversational and retrieval-augmented prompts; metric is median p95 latency over 10k samples. Full config in the factcheck doc."

Jamal: That appendix is perfect. I'll prepare a 1-paragraph elevator for email outreach + attach the factcheck link. Who's the backup speaker if Lucas gets pulled?

Priya: @Maria can present the demo if needed. Also recommend recording one internal dry-run tomorrow so press has a fallback clip. :camera_with_flash: 

Maria: I can do a dry-run at 10:30 PT tomorrow. Can folks RSVP here if they want to join: Jamal, Lucas, Claire?

Lucas: RSVP yes for dry-run.

Claire (Legal): I'll join for the quote review at dry-run. Quick ask: flag any third-party benchmark data in the factcheck doc.

Jamal: I'll sync the analyst invite list by EOD today. Plan: US slots 08:30 & 10:00 PT, EU slot 16:00 UTC. Each 30-min + 15-min fact-check. Press embargo window reiterated: Apr 12 08:00–12:00 PT.

Priya: Booking calendar invites now and adding 15-min buffer after each for follow-up fact checks. I'll add dial-in + recording toggle.

Maria: Perfect. Final checklist:
- Jamal: analyst invites + outreach copy
- Lucas: confirm benchmark config + paste raw numbers in factcheck doc
- Claire: final quote approval by Mon EOD
- Priya: calendar invites + recording

All: please add any last-minute items to the factcheck doc. :thumbsup:
